primary_web_reviews.finding: Complete current primary consultation read: distinct words are spaced, particles stay attached to their word; compound/suffix cases are distinct. This is not evidence that every proposed split is correct.

implementation: A separate dictionary-backed graph enumerates case-marked nominal word(s) followed by an independently analyzed lexical predicate. Existing raw word analyses and dictionary rules remain intact.
display_order: Fewer proposed spaces first, then original byte boundaries; this is a presentation order, not contextual confidence.
case_role: Existing class-1/2 nominal-particle grammar slots, including their licensed outer particles, plurals/suffixes, pronoun/case contractions and 음/기 nominalizations. No arbitrary connective is promoted to a nominal and no particle is made an auxiliary connector.
dictionary_policy: Every lemma in each segment must have a headword match and no known compatibility conflict. Unknown roles and per-entry homonyms are retained. Their sentence-level suitability is unjudged.

limits.semantics: Reached bounds mark complete=false with explicit limited_by reasons. CLI/library limits are configurable. Original tokens/candidates/spans remain present.

limitations: No ranking or contextual sentence validation. Extra dictionary-backed partitions remain unjudged rather than silently suppressed.
